name: wave-plinth
prompt: Photograph a small glossy ceramic pedestal shaped like a cresting ocean wave, glazed deep ocean blue breaking into foam white, its curl sculpted around a flat recessed shelf where an object can sit. A plain unbranded 16oz aluminum can stands squarely in that recess for scale, body blank with no logos or lettering, condensation beading on the metal and running down into the glaze. A magenta-purple LED bar glows behind at left, one soft warm key light rakes from the right. Shoot three-quarter from slightly above, the plinth right of center, the left third bare wood on a warm walnut desk at night in a small creative studio. Real ceramic texture, editorial product photography, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain.

name: tidepool-coaster
prompt: Shoot straight down onto a warm walnut desk at night in a small creative studio, filling the frame with a single cast resin coaster whose layered translucent blues stack like shallow water over pale sand. A purple-magenta LED bar rakes across from the left, one soft warm key light fills from above, and the bottom-left third stays bare wood grain. Photographic realism, visible dust and micro-scratches, shallow depth of field, film grain.
